title: aggregate node
description:
A consistency boundary: what must be consistent within one transaction. That is the whole test.

Prefer small — a large aggregate is a contention point and a lock held too long. One root, and it is the only element outside code reaches. Other aggregates are referenced by identity, never held. An invariant spanning two aggregates is eventually consistent and says so, rather than being buried inside a boundary drawn too wide to be honest.

root.description: The definition that is this aggregate's entry point. Exactly one, and its identity is the aggregate's.

x-alternation: Every field this kind requires is alternated separately against a gap naming that field, so a gap about one fact never excuses the absence of another. The shape is stated once in `../tables/invariants.json#/x-gap-alternation`. A prohibition is not excused: a gap says a fact is absent and cannot make a forbidden field allowed.
